messages.author: 9e1d805a26f6d719
messages.subject: cache default not getting set
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to get caching set up for a long-running Rmd script. Running knitr 1.5 under RStudio 0.98.484 and R 3.0.2 on a Linux box. 

The structure of the document looks like:

```{r setcache}
opts_knit$set(cache=TRUE)
```

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE, results='hide'}
options(stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

library(Matrix)
// stuff omitted
```

# lots of text omitted

```{r models}
// 3 functions defined
```

```{r model1, dependson='models'}
// one function defined
```
# lots more stuff and blocks...

When I try to knit the document, here's what I get:

 |.                                                                |   1%
   inline R code fragments

  |..                                                               |   3%
label: setcache
  |...                                                              |   4%
  ordinary text without R code

  |....                                                             |   6%
label: setup (with options) 
List of 3
 $ echo   : logi FALSE
 $ cache  : logi FALSE
 $ results: chr "hide"

  |.....                                                            |   7%
  ordinary text without R code

  |......                                                           |   9%
label: models
Warning: code chunks must not depend on the uncached chunk "models"
  |.......                                                          |  10%
  ordinary text without R code

  |........                                                         |  12%
label: model1 (with options) 
List of 1
 $ dependson: chr "models"

Warning: code chunks must not depend on the uncached chunk "model1"
  |........                                                         |  13%
  ordinary text without R code

Why I am getting the "code chunks must not depend on the uncached chunk "models"" warning? If I manually put cache=TRUE on that block, the warning goes away. It's like opts_knit$set(cache=TRUE) is having no effect. It doesn't seem to matter where I put that line -- it doesn't seem to enable the cache by default. Removing the cache directory and re-running doesn't help.

Any tips? Thanks!

 -Harlan

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] cache default not getting set
parts:
As Karl mentioned, the package options and chunk options are
confusing: http://kbroman.github.io/knitr_knutshell/pages/Rmarkdown.html
A rule of thumb is that you almost never need to set up package
options using opts_knit$set(), and most of the time you set chunk
options, i.e. opts_chunk$set() http://yihui.name/knitr/options

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
